record.question: The gold standard for diagnosis of UTI is:
record.explanation: Answer C: Urine culture. Urine culture is the microbiologic reference test that identifies urinary pathogens and susceptibilities, although uncomplicated cystitis may be diagnosed clinically in some patients. “Gold standard” should be limited to microbiologic confirmation. Reference: https://publications.aap.org/pediatrics/article/158/4/e2026078566/209462/Urinary-Tract-Infection-Diagnosis-A-Companion-to?searchresult=1; https://doi.org/10.1093/cid/ciae104. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
